items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 139:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the delights in MAN and MAD? At the time of the coupling, when the souls that are in the Nukva rise in her MAN and receive the aspect of their GAR through her GAR that causes delight, there is an aspect of delight to the ones coupling in the great completeness that the souls attained through the MAN and MAD of the coupling. As is said in the Zohar: "Go out and see, My son, in what I have come to you." (Item 63).
